This all sounds reasonable to me. I don't follow every technical detail, but reading it as the person who'll actually use the app, it lines up with what I asked for: pasting a link and getting the title and a picture, no duplicates, the search working the way we discussed (with the grouping left for later, as we agreed), the read-later list staying separate from favorites, notes with a bit of formatting that render safely, and archive being reversible while delete asks me first. I also like that my saved bookmarks stick around and that it can handle a big pile of them without getting slow.

The safety precautions around fetching page info are more than I'd have thought to ask for, and that's fine by me.

So yes, I approve the plan. Please go ahead and prepare the task breakdown.
